newsitem.title: USA: Saba well tests at 1.3 mln cubic feet/day.
newsitem.headline: Saba well tests at 1.3 mln cubic feet/day.

text.p: Saba Petroleum Co said Wednesday that the recently drilled Saba Gamma 17-8 well in Lamar County, Alabama tested at a rate of 1.3 million cubic feet per day with 400 psig back pressure.
Saba's working interest in the well is 68.75 percent and its revenue interest is 51.56 percent, the company said in a release.
Saba added that the well will be placed on production immediately.
The company said that so far, it has drilled three wells in Lamar County, Alabama, two of which have been producers and one a dry hole.
